# Muhamad Dendi Purwanto

Public portfolio: https://dendipur.web.id/

## Summary

Muhamad Dendi Purwanto is a Software Engineer based in Jawa Tengah, Indonesia. His public work focuses on web platforms, IoT systems, AI integrations, automation workflows, and full-stack product development.

## Public Roles

- Software Engineer at PT. Mayar Kernel Supernova.
- Freelance Developer at Deone Solutions.
- Owner and Lead Developer of Undangkeun from January 2024 to May 2025.

## Public Education

- Universitas Majalengka, Informatics, Bachelor of Computer Science, 2020-2024.
- SMK Negeri 1 Kertajati, electrical avionics, 2017-2020.

## Public Skills

- Web development: React.js, Node.js, Laravel, REST APIs.
- Data and backend: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Firebase.
- IoT: Arduino, ESP32, MQTT, sensor dashboards.
- Product and creative tools: Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator, CorelDRAW, Canva, CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro.
- AI integrations: generative media features, workflow automation, routers, plugins, and analytics exports.
